16_paper_title_and_claims.title: Reference-Induced Instability in Visual-Reference Segmentation: A Benchmark and Failure-Boundary Analysis
allowed_claims: Track A: Valid references induce substantial, measurable segmentation variability under the frozen matching-and-prompting pipeline, and this instability is associated with test-time-safe disagreement features.

Track B Utility-Only: Reference utility is predictable from test-time-safe features, but weighted consensus does not reduce variance; the utility signal is a scientific finding without a deployable stability gain.
